description: DNSSEC status of a domain over DNS-over-HTTPS: secure / insecure / bogus (validation failure) / island (signed but no DS at the parent), the zone apex, DS records (key tag, algorithm, digest type) and DNSKEYs (KSK / ZSK, algorithm, computed key tag), whether each DS digest really matches a published DNSKEY (recomputed locally), and warnings for deprecated algorithms or SHA-1 digests (RFC 8624). Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dnssec-check
